issue.title: rtcm messages unidentical with mavsdk::rtk.h

comments.body:
Hi, based on this small snippet (so no context): do you realize that rtcm is a stream of data? As long as the whole stream contains the same content, it is ok. Packets are sent in chunks.

Have you checked the whole stream for missing bytes?

Please correct me if I am wrong but this is my understanding at the moment.
@Wenz922 are you using v2 or v3? With v3 the rtcm data needs to be supplied base64 encoded.

Correct, no base64 with v2.

And so are corrections not working at all? Can you share any other information about your setup? E.g. PX4 or ArduPilot? And what versions?

Hi @julianoes , i have checked the version of MAVSDK and PX4 which i used. And the RTK devices are two H-RTK ZED-F9P Helical, one as Base and another one as Rover. Configuration is as followed : https://docs.holybro.com/gps-and-rtk-system/zed-f9p-h-rtk-series/portable-rtk-base-station-setup. It works well directly with holybro telemtry radio. Is it probably the reason of holybro telemtry with baudrate 57600?
I will have to create a C++ example and test that myself.
@julianoes that will be great! thanks a lot, stay updated ;)
Hi, fwiw, I will double check my setup with MAVSDK v3.0.0 since I have used my setup successfully with MAVSDK v2
@reedev would you mind to share more detail, for example the code part of library rtk.h?

As I said, I will check MAVSDK v3 with rtk, to see if it still works as expected as with v2. We know that v2 was working ok so I suggest to make your setup with v2 first.

I don't see that you tried your setup with a different setup, are you sure your equipment, server etc are working properly?

Sorry, @reedev i don't really understand what kind of setup do you mean here, could you explain a bit more?
What i have tried: setup Base & Rover, communication with (1) holybro telemtry without MAVSDK; (2) TCP; (3) pixhawk 6c with MAVSDK. The results are: (1)and(2) work greatly with RTK, (3) doesn't work so far.

Aha sorry, I missed that part of your story. In that case I can't help you much further since my equipment and setup is completely different. I will test MAVSDK v3 to make sure that the MAVSDK is working ok.
Hi @julianoes sorry to bother you, do you have any updates about this issue? Or are there any alternative solutions?
@reedev no problem, would you mind to share your setup? Probably i could learn from it.
It's on my list to recreate the setup.
whenever I have more details to share, I will get back.

@Wenz922 Cloud you please share 
`$ listener gps_inject_data` in PX4 NuttX shell for ensure RTCM was come in PX4 in case MAVSDK and Holybro telemetry

I found my old example and updated it for MAVSDK v3, see if this works for you: https://github.com/julianoes/rtk-sender-example

I haven't recently tested it but will do so later today.
Ok, just tested this with a CubePilot Here+ base and Holybro H-RTK Unicore UM982 one the drone side, and successfully got into RTK fixed.

@julianoes Ok, thanks very much for your confirm that it is not the problem of code. Could you share the detail of setting?
I realize since last week that it could be the problem of setting of RTK. I have the RTK F9P Helical (base and rover) and tested firstly with QGroundControl with default configuration, they got also successfully into RTK fixed (https://docs.px4.io/main/en/gps_compass/rtk_gps.html), I could find the parameters RTK_INJECT_GPS1 and gps_inject_data in QGC. But since i manually configured the base and rover with u-center (https://docs.holybro.com/gps-and-rtk-system/zed-f9p-h-rtk-series/portable-rtk-base-station-setup), these parameters were disappeared in QGC and they couldn't get in RTK fixed @aminballoon . Does anyone have more information? Thank you in advance!
I don't know my configuration. I didn't mess with that.

Fwiw, I tested with MAVSDK v3 and after I changed the rtcm data into base64, everything was still working as before. I don't have a special setup, just using rtcm data from some ntrip server, convert it to base64 and send it via the rtk plugin.

I have no special params set.
Hi @julianoes it works greatly with RTK Fix while i use default configuration, thanks a lot anyway!
Ok great. I assume we can close this issue then.
